script_line: Go to your own stairs and come down forwards. You will know in a minute.

risks.risk: a hand goes to the rail (the user's earlier fix)
risks.prevented_by: both hands free, never touching the banister; no hand on the rail

risks.risk: the strap slides as the knee bends
risks.prevented_by: worn-constancy line; no strap sliding down the leg
RIG-R1C: the phone stays at the foot of the stairs
